Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

barcurateR 0.3.0

Key changes

  • sequence_gap is now informational: gap characters and IUPAC codes no longer exclude a record from the passing set. Re-curate existing databases.
  • frameshifted is now determined by internal stop codons in the best of six reading frames, not by sequence length modulo 3. Partial in-frame CDS (including the 658 bp Folmer barcode) are no longer flagged.
  • rb_compile_qc_flags() replaces the extra_flag_fn mechanism. qc_flag contains only excluding flags; informational conditions are in the new qc_note column.

New features

  • rb_sequence_composition() reports character-class composition without modifying sequences.
  • rb_check_codons() evaluates six frames, tolerates ambiguous codons, and ignores terminal stops. New metadata: n_internal_stops, best_frame, coding_strand, frame_complete, codon_check_run.
  • rb_check_rrna_integrity() reports n_gap_chars, n_ambiguous, n_base, frac_ambig, max_gap_run; length checks use biological length.
  • Optional max_ambiguous_frac exclusion threshold in rb_compile_qc_flags().

Bug fixes

  • Alignment padding no longer crashes DECIPHER::AlignSeqs() in rb_build_gene_tree() and rb_run_barcode_gap().
  • Classifier length feature uses biological rather than stored string length.
